main_body: Sci-fi control-tower building: a stepped structure with an upper sloped roof and a windowed drum, a central pillar, a wide lower sloped roof, and a base with a double door.
top_band: Column through the middle of the lower body: light blue-grey sloped roof panels at rows ~52-62, with panel seams. A lighter highlight band at rows ~60-62 marks the front edge. The upper roof is a similar light slope at rows ~8-16.
evidence: Both roofs are drawn as foreshortened sloped surfaces several rows tall. The upper one is about 8 rows and the lower one about 10 rows. Each sits above a distinct front face: the window drum at rows 17-29 and the door base at rows 63-79. A light edge line and a dark band under each roof edge read as an eave shadow. The door and windows are set in dark frames, so they read as inset. No receding side faces are drawn.

style.evidence: The silhouette has a near-black outline all the way round, which gives a sticker look; Beodeul uses a dark tone of the adjacent material instead. The roof has only about 3-4 blue-grey steps and carries no per-tile texture or dots. The pillar, the dark base and the window frames are large flat fills. Most tiles hold only 3-5 colours, far below the references' roof tiles, plaster speckle and stone shading.
